_about: How much a word OCR finds on a generated picture must prove before composition counts it (scripts/velib/qc_composition.py photo_word). Krish, 2026-11-19, of the habits short: tesseract read photo texture as words ("JUI" at y 1099, conf 75, on the b14 stampers picture; "a»" at x 931, conf 93, on the b17 boxes picture) and failed the cut on caption_zone and platform_zone. A generated picture (a photo_plate drawn from a still image) carries no text the engine drew, so a word found on it counts only with strong evidence. Screen recordings and footage (a photo_plate from a video) and every other beat keep the house rule unchanged.

photo_word.why: Real words on a picture read at 92 to 97 conf and four letters or more in every frame measured on 19 Nov; the misreads were a 3-letter word at 75 and a 1-letter glyph at 93. One stray glyph or short low-confidence read is texture, not type.
